tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search the open job vacancies of Azerbaijan's job market on BirJob (birjob.com), which gathers about 90 Azerbaijani job sites and employers' career pages into one index, each job listed once; it also lists Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Turkey, Georgia and Kyrgyzstan. Use this when the user asks for jobs o

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read one job on BirJob by its id (from search_jobs) or its birjob.com URL. Use this when the user wants the full description, requirements or how to apply for a job already found. Returns title, company, place, salary, work format, employment type, seniority, dates, the whole description and require

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Find employers on BirJob by name, with how many open jobs each has and the URL of its birjob.com company page. Use this when the user names or asks about an employer (şirkət, company, компания), or wants the biggest hirers: without a query it lists the employers with the most open jobs in Azerbaijan

tools.name: similar_jobs
tools.description: Open jobs like one BirJob job (by its id from search_jobs, or its birjob.com URL): the same kind of role in other words and languages, in the same country, the same city first. Use this when the user likes a job and asks for more like it. 10 a page by default, with the same fields as search_jobs. Do

tools.name: new_since
tools.description: Jobs BirJob first listed after a given time that match the same filters as search_jobs, newest first, with the same fields. Use this when the user asks what is new since a date or since the last check: keep the time of each call and pass it as since next time. since may be up to 30 days back. Do not

tools.name: match_jobs
tools.description: Rank open jobs in Azerbaijan on BirJob against a role, skills or CV text, with the words each job matched and why. Use this when the user shares a CV or a list of skills and asks which jobs fit. Pass title, skills and/or cv_text: they are used for this one call and not stored. No sign-in needed. Or

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save a job to the user's BirJob saved jobs (the same list as on birjob.com). Use this when the user asks to save, bookmark or keep a job for later. Saving a saved job again changes nothing. Do not use to record an application (track_application). Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the firs

tools.name: get_saved_jobs
tools.description: List the user's saved jobs on BirJob, newest first, with each job's birjob.com URL; a job no longer open is marked closed. Use this when the user asks what they saved. Do not use for applications (get_applications). Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to sign in

tools.name: unsave_job
tools.description: Remove a job from the user's BirJob saved jobs. Use this only when the user asks to remove or unsave a job. Cannot be undone from here; the job can be saved again with save_job. Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to sign in to BirJob and allow access.

tools.name: track_application
tools.description: Record where the user is with a job on BirJob: saved, applied, interview, offer, rejected. Use this when the user says they applied, got an interview, an offer or a rejection. Calling it again for the same job replaces the earlier status. Do not use to apply: it records the status for the user only,

tools.name: get_applications
tools.description: List the user's tracked applications on BirJob, most recently changed first, optionally by status. Use this when the user asks where they applied or how their applications stand. Do not use for saved jobs (get_saved_jobs). Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to

tools.name: create_job_alert
tools.description: Save a search (the same filters as search_jobs) to check later with get_new_matches. Use this when the user wants to follow a search over time. Each call saves another search. Nothing is emailed or sent on a schedule: new jobs are found only when get_new_matches is called. Do not use for a one-off s

tools.name: get_job_alerts
tools.description: List the user's saved searches on BirJob, with their ids for get_new_matches and delete_job_alert. Use this when the user asks which searches they follow. Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to sign in to BirJob and allow access.

tools.name: delete_job_alert
tools.description: Delete one of the user's saved searches. Use this only when the user asks to stop following a search. Cannot be undone; the search can be saved again with create_job_alert. Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to sign in to BirJob and allow access.

tools.name: get_new_matches
tools.description: The jobs that reached BirJob since this saved search was last checked and match it, newest first, up to 10, each with its birjob.com URL.
